n2m_cpu_alu.description: nand2mario initial LR35902 arithmetic and logic contract

n2m_dual_port_ram_dual_collision_fail.description: Deliberate nand2mario dual-clock RAM collision failure proof

n2m_dual_port_ram_reset.description: nand2mario RAM reset suppression and data-hold contract

n2m_interfaces.description: nand2mario interface package shape and encoding contract

n2m_partial_read_write_fail.description: Deliberate nand2mario partial same-port collision failure proof

n2m_cpu.description: Complete LR35902 CPU architectural and protocol contract

n2m_memory.description: nand2mario Game Boy memory map: regions, echo, defaults, IE, peripheral port, cartridge port with a stalling backing and one response per request

n2m_system.description: n2m_system composition: timebase, CPU, DMA, memory map, cartridge, timer, interrupt flags, PPU, joypad, the VGA display tier, serial and the UART loader run a local program through timer, joypad and serial interrupts to an exact memory signature and serial byte string

n2m_timer.description: nand2mario Game Boy timer: DIV/TIMA/TMA/TAC rates, write-induced edges, overflow reload and interrupt pulse

n2m_interrupts.description: nand2mario interrupt-flag register: source set, CPU write, acknowledge priority and IF readback

n2m_ppu.description: nand2mario PPU background layer: LCD registers, raster/mode timing, access blocking, pixel stream and STAT/VBlank edges against the Python model

n2m_ppu_stat.description: nand2mario literal STAT source boundaries and shared-line blocking through public PPU ports

n2m_ppu_objects.description: nand2mario PPU window and objects: OAM scan, 8x8/8x16 objects, flips, palettes, priority, the ten-per-line limit, X ordering and the window against the Python renderer

n2m_ppu_window.description: nand2mario PPU window geometry and line counter: WX 0-6, 7, 166 and above 166 with visible pixels, WY start, and hide/resume through LCDC.0 and LCDC.5 against hand-built expected lines

n2m_dma.description: nand2mario OAM DMA: register, start delay, 160-byte copy from every source page through the memory map, CPU restriction during the transfer and restart

n2m_system_background.description: n2m_system background frame: a local program draws a scrolled background, waits for the VBlank interrupt and one captured frame matches the Python renderer pixel for pixel

n2m_system_objects.description: n2m_system objects frame: a local program draws background, window and sprites, copies OAM through DMA from a VBlank handler and one captured frame matches the Python renderer pixel for pixel

n2m_joypad.description: nand2mario Game Boy joypad register P1: row selects, active-low lines, selected-active level and the selected-line-fall interrupt/wake pulse

n2m_serial.description: nand2mario Game Boy serial port SB/SC: internal-clock 8192 Hz transfer, completion interrupt, transmitted-byte observation, external-clock wait

n2m_apu.description: nand2mario powered-off DMG APU gateway: FF10-FF2F read-back masks with writes ignored (NR52 $70), FF30-FF3F wave RAM write/readback and reset clear, unclaimed addresses outside FF10-FF3F, against the Python model

n2m_cartridge.description: nand2mario cartridge mapper: header-selected ROM-only/MBC1 behavior, bank registers, RAM enable and the stall-capable backing port against the Python MBC1 model

n2m_cartridge_backing.description: nand2mario on-chip cartridge backing: load port, ROM reads, RAM writes/reads and the one-edge backing port response

n2m_cartridge_backing_rom_write_fail.description: Deliberate nand2mario cartridge backing ROM-write rejection proof

n2m_system_mbc1.description: n2m_system MBC1: a local 1 MiB / 32 KiB-RAM program switches ROM and RAM banks in both modes, runs code from switched banks and leaves an exact WRAM and cartridge RAM signature

n2m_display.description: nand2mario display tier: frame bridge bank policy (swap at the raster origin, drop, repeat, LCD-off blank and its priority over completion), three-bank frame store, 3x scaled centered scanout, palette, border and the common VGA sync timing against the Python model

n2m_display_snapshot.description: nand2mario display frame snapshot: frame IDs, pin/release against swap, repeat, drop and the raster origin, the LCD-off blank under a pin, no pin before the first frame, reset, the 5768-byte record read through the shared frame-store read port with the VGA output unchanged, against the Python display model

n2m_system_vga.description: n2m_system VGA frame: the background program draws a scrolled background, one captured PPU frame matches the Python renderer and one complete captured 640x480 VGA frame equals that frame scaled 3x and centered with the documented palette, border and sync timing

n2m_system_snapshot.description: n2m_system frame snapshot: the owned animated program scrolls every frame while the UART host pins, reads and releases three displayed frames with the capture tool's sequence; each decoded record equals the PPU frame of its ID, the VGA output during a pin equals the pinned frame, no swap while pinned, NO_FRAME/NOT_PINNED before the first frame and after a HOLD

n2m_sdram_ctrl.description: nand2mario SDRAM controller (adapt-MIT) against the owned IS42S16320D device model: power-up initialization sequence and clock numbers, CL2 single-beat reads and byte-masked writes, response/ready latencies, refresh cadence and randomized traffic against the Python pin monitor and shadow

n2m_sdram_refresh_fail.description: Deliberate nand2mario SDRAM device-model refresh deadline proof: a controller refreshing every 220 clocks trips the model's 195-clock interval check

n2m_sdram_backing.description: nand2mario SDRAM cartridge backing: backing port and load port over the controller and device model, ROM/RAM placement, byte lanes, latencies, initialization stall, arbitration and randomized two-port traffic against the Python shadow

n2m_sdram_backing_rom_write_fail.description: Deliberate nand2mario SDRAM backing ROM-write rejection proof

n2m_uart_loader.description: nand2mario UART loader: framed PING/HOLD/RELEASE/WRITE/READ and SNAP_PIN/SNAP_RELEASE/SNAP_READ with CRC-16, buffered commit, readback, hold level, the snapshot pin and record with a pin lost under a payload, every status code, framing/timeout/overrun flags and randomized frames against the Python protocol model over a bench-played stalling load port and display snapshot port

n2m_system_sdram.description: n2m_system SDRAM boot: the UART loader holds the core, writes an owned 8-bank MBC1 image into the SDRAM device model through the adapted controller, reads part of it back, releases the core, the program runs from SDRAM through MBC1 to an exact signature and the cartridge RAM is read back over UART

n2m_system_preload.description: n2m_system direct preload: the whole owned 8-bank MBC1 image is written through the direct preload port right after reset with the core running, the UART loader (bench host on the serial pins) reads samples back, a direct patch and a UART restore interleave while the core is held, and after RELEASE the program runs to the exact SDRAM-boot signature

n2m_system_sdram_preload.description: n2m_system direct preload with the SDRAM backing: a direct write held through system reset and the SDRAM power-up is accepted only once initialized, the whole owned 8-bank image is preloaded through the controller with the core running, the UART loader reads samples back and interleaves with direct patches while the core is held, and after RELEASE the program runs to the exact SDRAM-boot signature

n2m_de10_lite.description: nand2mario DE10-Lite board top with the portable clock backend and the common Virtual JTAG stub on the SDRAM device model: PLL lock and reset release, SDRAM initialization hold, the background image loaded over the loader UART pins and read back, the program run from SDRAM, status LEDs and 7-segment digits, one VGA frame captured on the board pins, JTAG keyboard joypad scans and the debounced SW/KEY fallback

n2m_de2_115.description: DE2-115 portable board smoke: low-half SDRAM UART load, execution, ADV7123 DAC edge/width, complete UART frame snapshot, JTAG and fallback input

n2m_system_sw_games.description: Original nand2mario games built from committed source (src/nand2mario/cfg/sw-games.json): a finite Start/Right scenario with frame evidence on the unmodified system, run through src/nand2mario/scripts/sw_build/sw_games.py run

n2m_system_mooneye.description: One pinned Mooneye acceptance ROM (src/nand2mario/cfg/mooneye.json) on the unmodified system; the Mooneye LD B,B breakpoint registers from the retirement record give the verdict, run through src/nand2mario/scripts/regression/mooneye.py

n2m_system_mooneye_long.description: One pinned Mooneye acceptance ROM (src/nand2mario/cfg/mooneye.json) on the unmodified system; the Mooneye LD B,B breakpoint registers from the retirement record give the verdict, run through src/nand2mario/scripts/regression/mooneye.py Long bound (40 M cycles) for ROMs that legitimately run past the default, such as timer/div_write.

n2m_system_ppu_trace.description: PPU timing trace aid (src/nand2mario/dv/conformance/test_ppu_trace.py): loads one ROM like the Mooneye harness and writes STAT mode, STAT interrupt and CPU retirement events with cycle, dot and LY to N2M_TRACE_OUT; checked by src/nand2mario/scripts/regression/mooneye.py trace-smoke

n2m_system_games.description: Three pinned real game programs: bounded CPU progress, ordered PPU frames and controlled button scenarios

n2m_library.description: Pinned menu library ABI: snapshot banks, validated image swaps, CRC failure and host recovery

n2m_system_menu.description: Unchanged donor menu and original test images on the enabled native library: pixel-exact splash/navigation/refusal, direct game and MBC1 return

n2m_system_menu_sdram.description: Same independent 50-frame menu scenario with real SDRAM controller/model and UART HOLD-load-readback-RELEASE

n2m_dual_port_ram_shared.description: nand2mario ASIC RAM backend: the shared single-port path (8 KiB VRAM/WRAM store over n2a_sync_ram) equals the portable two-port contract edge for edge under the documented sharing rule, including posted writes under port-B bursts and their forwarding

n2m_system_asic_ram.description: n2m_system composition: timebase, CPU, DMA, memory map, cartridge, timer, interrupt flags, PPU, joypad, the VGA display tier, serial and the UART loader run a local program through timer, joypad and serial interrupts to an exact memory signature and serial byte string; with the ASIC RAM backend (n2m_dual_port_ram_asic.sv over the behavioral n2a_sync_ram), so VRAM and WRAM run on the shared single-port store

n2m_system_objects_asic_ram.description: n2m_system objects frame: a local program draws background, window and sprites, copies OAM through DMA from a VBlank handler and one captured frame matches the Python renderer pixel for pixel; with the ASIC RAM backend (n2m_dual_port_ram_asic.sv over the behavioral n2a_sync_ram), so VRAM and WRAM run on the shared single-port store
